justification: Inspected `ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/Dialogs.java`: `Response` is a nested enum with only 3 constants (`NO`, `YES`, `NEVER`) and no methods or fields, while the dialog-building logic is implemented in the outer `Dialogs` class. Its usages in `EditorPane.java`, `SandboxStage.java`, and `MainConfigStage.java` treat it only as a simple return/status token, so the enum itself is not under-modularized.
